prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching an intersection in Houston, Texas, when the vehicle was struck on its driver side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was eastbound and entered the intersection against a steady signal. On arrival, I observed that the point of impact on Driver 1's vehicle was consistent with a broadside collision, with crush damage concentrated along the driver door and quarter panel. The damage pattern corresponds closely to the reported force of the impact. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's position and reported pain in the right shoulder, which is consistent with the mechanism of this collision. A Passenger was also present in the front seat and was able to confirm the sequence of events. Statements from two independent witnesses at the corner, along with photographs taken at the scene, support the account given by Driver 1 and Driver 2 regarding how the collision occurred. Driver 2 acknowledged entering the intersection and did not dispute the sequence. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to any party at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy.
